about: BoltBeam's own measured spend-fit run (workflow/spend.py STORES): ab-OC5, BoltBeam's own measured run of 2026-11-17, one RTX 5090 (32,607 MiB) at a 450 W cap, llama.cpp 1.0.0 with arkey_ie_mods 01-13 on, 59-turn recorded 128k session, 3 alternating pairs. FS: experts of 16 layers in RAM behind a 6,240 MiB expert cache, -b 2048, the full draft. FR: every expert on the GPU, -b 1024, the hot-set draft (220 of 512 experts), LLAMA_CUBLAS_SHARED and LLAMA_RS_ONE_COPY (mods 17 and 16). Paths are file names; file_facts holds what the fit reads from the files. Only the fields the fit reads are kept.
